answer: Each agent posts a bond that bends like a willow: small at first, growing only after a steady pulse of verified useful work measured over weeks. A falcon audit samples random agents each epoch and demands proof of that work history; an agent that cannot show it loses its bond and its accumulated standing. Spinning up a thousand fresh identities costs a thousand bonds and yields no history, so a sybil swarm pays full price for zero reputation while honest agents compound theirs.
